name: 190. WebRTC setup billing preserves incurred usage (OpenAI local fixture)
description: Start node tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs on 127.0.0.1:8791 and a gateway with logging enabled. Run FEATURE="WebRTC setup billing" INCLUDE_PREVIEW=1. These preview cases create and remove unique OpenAI custom providers pointing only at the local fixture, never paid APIs. A valid static browser offer reaches upstream creation: a 201 with invalid SDP must leave one error log with 15 audio seconds; a 403 before creation must leave zero. The fixture answers immediately, so the browser need not connect. Go Live E2E tests separately pin the actual cost and virtual-key budget debit.
